questions.question: You see an unattended bag near the hall entrance. What should you do?
options: Move it out of the way
questions.explain: Never touch unattended items. Report them to security or soldiers at once.

questions.question: When travelling to your PPA, which is the safest choice?
options: Travel at night to avoid traffic
Use registered motor parks and travel by day
Accept a free ride from a stranger
questions.explain: Travel in daylight using registered transport. Many incidents happen on night journeys.

questions.question: Which is the best way to prevent malaria in camp?
options: Sleep under a treated mosquito net
questions.explain: Insecticide-treated nets are one of the most effective protections against malaria.

questions.question: What should you drink if you have diarrhoea?
questions.explain: ORS replaces lost water and salts. See the clinic if it doesn't stop.

questions.question: Your allawee has just come in. What is a smart first step?
options: Set aside rent, food and transport money first
Lend it all to a friend
Invest it in a scheme promising 3x returns
questions.explain: Budget for needs first. Schemes promising huge returns are usually scams.

questions.question: Someone promises to double your money in two weeks. This is most likely:
questions.explain: Guaranteed high returns in a short time are a classic sign of a scam.

questions.question: What is monthly clearance?
options: A party at the end of the month
Signing at your local government office to show you are at your post
questions.explain: Clearance confirms you are serving. Missing it can delay your allawee.

questions.question: What is CDS?
options: Community Development Service, a weekly group activity
questions.explain: CDS groups meet weekly to carry out projects that help the community.

questions.question: What is a PPA?
options: Your Place of Primary Assignment, where you work
questions.explain: Your PPA is the school, office or organisation you serve in after camp.

questions.question: What can happen if you abandon your PPA for long periods?
options: You may get a query or have your service extended
questions.explain: Absconding has serious consequences, including extension of service.

questions.question: What does SAED aim to do for corps members?
options: Help them gain skills to earn a living
questions.explain: SAED teaches trades and entrepreneurship so you can earn during and after service.

questions.question: Which is the most important safety habit in a vehicle?
questions.explain: Seat belts greatly reduce the risk of death or serious injury in crashes.

questions.question: Your driver is speeding and overtaking dangerously. What should you do?
options: Politely ask him to slow down
questions.explain: Passengers can and should speak up. Your life matters more than arriving early.

questions.question: Which habit best prevents typhoid?
options: Drinking clean water and washing hands
questions.explain: Typhoid spreads through contaminated food and water. Hygiene is the key.

questions.question: You are posted to a community with a culture different from yours. What is best?
questions.explain: Respecting local culture builds trust and makes your service year easier and richer.

questions.question: A stranger online offers you a well-paid job if you send your BVN and pay a 'processing fee'. You should:
questions.explain: Never share your BVN or pay fees for job offers. Real employers don't ask for that.

questions.question: Which is a good way to save during the service year?
options: Save a fixed amount each month in a separate account
questions.explain: Automatic monthly saving, even small amounts, adds up by passing out.

questions.question: You feel feverish with headache and body pain. You should:
options: Get tested at a clinic for malaria or typhoid
questions.explain: Test before treating. Self-medication can hide serious illness.

questions.question: What do you need before collecting your certificate at passing out?
questions.explain: You must complete final clearance before you can collect your certificate.

questions.question: When the bugle sounds at 4:30am, you should:
options: Get up and fall in at the parade ground
questions.explain: Late-comers get punished. Fall in immediately when the bugle sounds.
